boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-cost ways to gather, learn, browse, and explore through UMD programs and spaces.

cards.entity_name: Fall Volunteer & Engagement Fair + Volunteers in Action Service Project
cards.title: Browse the Volunteer Fair
cards.subtitle: Kirby Ballroom • September 10, 2026
cards.notes: Meet representatives from local organizations, compare ways to get involved, and bring a friend to walk the tables together.
cards.short_summary: A free campus fair for connecting with Twin Ports service opportunities.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD lists the September 10, 2026 Fall Volunteer & Engagement Fair in Kirby Ballroom with a cost of FREE.
cards.access_notes: For students, faculty, and staff; scheduled 10 a.m.–2 p.m. September 10 in Kirby Ballroom.

cards.entity_name: Science on Deck: The Waves on the Great Lakes
cards.title: Tour the Blue Heron
cards.subtitle: DECC Twin Ports Harbor • August 28, 2026
cards.notes: Board the R/V Blue Heron for the crew-led tour, browse freshwater-research displays, and catch the afternoon lake-waves talk.
cards.short_summary: A free public research-vessel tour and Great Lakes science program.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD says its August 28, 2026 Science on Deck program offers free public tours and research displays at DECC Twin Ports Harbor.
cards.source_title: Science on Deck kicks off the 2026 season | University of Minnesota Duluth
cards.access_notes: Scheduled 11 a.m.–3 p.m. August 28 at DECC Twin Ports Harbor near the Great Lakes Aquarium, 353 Harbor Dr.

cards.title: Walk the Greenhouse
cards.subtitle: Swenson Science Building • 1035 Kirby Drive
cards.notes: Drop in with a friend to see flowering plants and the botanical collection; keep the visit within weekday public-access hours.
cards.short_summary: A year-round, free botanical stop on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD states that its Biology greenhouses are free and open to the public year-round on weekdays, excluding observed holidays.
cards.source_title: Greenhouse | Swenson College of Science and Engineering
cards.access_notes: Drop-in visitors are welcome Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; observed University holidays are excluded.

cards.title: Browse the Free Store
cards.subtitle: Chem 213
cards.notes: Visit during open hours, look through donated items, and limit selections to four items per visit so the shared resource stays useful.
cards.short_summary: A campus donation-based shop where students may take items without purchase.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD says students may shop the Free Store during the semester and limits items taken to four per visit.
cards.source_title: Free Store | Sustainability | University of Minnesota Duluth
cards.access_notes: Open when classes are in session: Monday 12:30–5 p.m., Wednesday 3–5 p.m., and Thursday 10 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.entity_name: Duluth Sister Cities: Person to Person Diplomacy
cards.title: Hear about Sister Cities
cards.subtitle: Kirby Plaza 311 • September 28, 2026
cards.notes: Bring a friend for the Kirby Plaza talk, then use the no-registration format to make it an easy midday campus meetup.
cards.short_summary: A free public UMD lecture on Duluth’s sister-city relationships.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD lists “Duluth Sister Cities: Person to Person Diplomacy” for September 28, 2026 in its free, public Journey Jargon & Lecture Series.
cards.source_title: University for Seniors | University of Minnesota Duluth
cards.access_notes: Held at 11:30 a.m. in Kirby Plaza 311 and via Zoom; no registration is required and seating is based on availability.
